tools.name: assess_weather_risk
tools.description: [$0.10 USDC/call · Solana USDC · x402] Entry point for every agent flow. Given a business location and type, returns a weather risk score (0-1), the top perils ranked by severity, historical frequency data, and an overall risk level (low/moderate/high/severe). Powered by 5 years of Open-Meteo historical data — returns real data, not sandbox. Always call this first before requesting a quote.

params.name: location
params.description: City and state of the business, e.g. 'Tampa, FL' or 'Kansas City, MO'.

params.name: business_type
params.description: Type of business. Determines which perils are most relevant.

tools.name: get_parametric_quote
tools.description: Request a parametric insurance quote for a specific peril and coverage period. Returns quote_id, carrier, premium, trigger threshold, payout amount, and coverage terms. Pass the quote_id to bind_policy to activate the policy.

params.name: location
params.description: City and state of the business, e.g. 'Miami, FL'.

params.name: payout_limit
params.description: Maximum payout amount in USD (e.g. 50000 for $50,000).

params.name: revenue_band
params.description: Optional. Annual revenue band for premium calibration.

params.name: coverage_period_end
params.description: Coverage end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: coverage_period_start
params.description: Coverage start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: bind_policy
tools.description: Accept a quote and initiate a bind. This activates the policy and begins trigger monitoring. Returns policy_id, effective and expiration dates, trigger details, and a confirmation. Pass quote_id from get_parametric_quote. This is where coverage begins.

params.name: payment_method
params.description: Payment method for the policy premium. Sandbox: no charge applied.

params.name: client_business_name
params.description: Legal name of the insured business.

params.name: client_contact_email
params.description: Email address of the client contact.

tools.name: check_trigger
tools.description: Check whether a bound policy's parametric trigger is currently met. Returns the current observed weather value versus the trigger threshold, whether the trigger is met, and the data source. In production this calls NOAA and ERA5. Currently returns simulated sandbox data.

tools.name: get_policy_status
tools.description: Get the full current status of a bound parametric policy: active, triggered, settled, or expired. Returns client details, trigger threshold, premium paid, payout amount, coverage dates, and the complete trigger event history.

tools.name: list_carriers
tools.description: List all carriers currently registered on the ParaSure platform. Returns carrier name, supported perils, supported regions, and available products. Free — no payment required. Use this to discover coverage options before calling get_parametric_quote.
